name: One on One Basketball Summer Hoops Camps (Rhode Island)
description_short: Weeklong basketball day camps run by One on One Basketball (camp director Coach Frank Luca) at Moses Brown School in Providence, plus an August week at the South Kingstown Recreational Center. Ages 5-15, full day or half day (morning or afternoon), shooting, defense and court-awareness stations, scrimmages and skills competitions, 9 to 1 camper-to-coach ratio. No prior experience needed.

warnings: All sessions on this page are from summer 2026 (August 10-14 and August 24-28, 2026). They have already happened as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 dates or prices are posted.

This page lists programs at two different places: Moses Brown School (Providence) and South Kingstown Recreational Center (30 St Dominic Rd, South Kingstown, RI 02879). The listing address is Moses Brown. South Kingstown sessions sign up through the Town of South Kingstown's rec1 site instead.
The full-day price is different at each place ($345 at Moses Brown, $200 at South Kingstown), so no single weekly rate was recorded.
Smithfield (127 Swan Rd) is the operator's mailing address, not where camp is held.
